responsibility: This implementation module manages runtime module dependency resolution for GNU Modula-2. It stores registered modules in state-partitioned doubly linked lists, records init/fini callbacks and dependency procedures, traces and optionally warns through environment-controlled debug flags, resolves and orders dependencies across application and library modules, then drives construction and reverse-order destruction. It is the core dependency-graph engine underneath the higher-level M2RTS startup/shutdown wrappers.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation side of the M2Dependent pair: it contains the module-chain data structures, state lists, dependency resolution, tracing, and constructor/destructor execution logic. Unlike gcc/m2/gm2-libs/M2Dependent.def, it is the runtime engine behind the declared API.
